question: Can a product-level no-war model for purchases from Russia (to_rus) beat 2021 held flat by >= 15% in every back-test, and narrow the band at the same coverage?
rule: a candidate (M1, M1b, M2; fixed in advance) replaces M0 only if its error (mean over H1-H5 of the median absolute cumulative log error) is >= 15% lower in each of the tests at origins 2007, 2012 and 2016; it narrows a band only if its era-calibrated 90% band is narrower than M0's built the same way

data.trade: CEPII BACI HS92 via OEC API: Russia's exports to each partner by HS2, 2001-2021 (USD, FOB)
data.prices: Fisher chained unit-value indices of Russia's exports to the world by HS4 (fuel HS27, cereals HS10, fertilisers HS31, metals HS72-76); other goods: FRED IREXFUELS (US import prices excluding fuels)
data.weo: IMF WEO October vintage of the origin year (DBnomics WEOAGG): world goods import volume growth (TMG_RPCH) and APSP crude price path (POILAPSP)

models.M0: total held flat at the origin year (real, origin prices); flows under EUR 1bn a year (size S, M) start from the median of the three years to the origin, as the map's small_flow_base
models.M1: five product groups (fuel HS27, cereals HS10, fertilisers HS31, metals HS72-76, other), each held flat in real terms with the same start rule as M0 (identical to M0 for L flows: the sum of groups held flat at the origin year's prices is the total held flat)
models.M1b: each group from the median of its own three years to the origin, for all sizes
models.M2v: M1, with fuel and fertiliser volumes moved by the WEO world goods import volume forecast
models.M2p: M1, with fuel volume moved by (WEO crude price forecast / origin)^beta, beta the pooled elasticity of fuel volume to Russia's fuel export price on pre-origin pairs
models.M2: M2v and M2p together (fuel: volume x price response; fertiliser: volume; other groups flat). Origin 2007 has no WEO vintage on DBnomics, so M2 = M1 there (variant: April 2008 vintage)
models.O_total: oracle, not eligible: the total moved by Russia's realised real exports to all other partners
models.O_groups: oracle, not eligible: each group moved by Russia's realised real exports of that group to all other partners (what product detail could add with perfect knowledge of Russia's supply)

uncertain_countries.note: size class of to_rus in counterfactual.json; current bands are the generic size-class bands x0.81
